worlds.name: Training Camp
worlds.blurb: Warm up. Beat the boss to open every world.

levels.title: Every Clue
levels.tipText: Welcome to Training Camp! Tap the ear when you are ready. Wait until I finish talking. Then do what I said.

levels.title: Two Steps
levels.tipText: Two things to do now. Tap them in the order I say. Then press the green check mark. Made a slip? The arrow takes it back.

levels.title: Tricky Words
levels.tipText: Listen for the tricky words: not, all, except, next to, left, and right.

levels.title: Before and After
levels.tipText: Before and after. Sometimes I say it backwards. Think: what comes first?

levels.title: Captain's Orders
levels.tipText: Only do it if it is a real order. If it is not, tap the hand.

levels.title: Camp Boss
levels.tipText: Camp Boss! Three and four steps, tricky words, and changes of plan. Beat me to open every world.

worlds.name: Rookie Camp
worlds.blurb: One thing at a time. Listen for every clue.

levels.title: Name It
levels.tipText: Welcome to Rookie Camp! Here is how it works. Tap the ear when you are ready to listen. Wait until I finish talking. Then tap what I said.

levels.title: Color It
levels.tipText: Now listen for the color. Some of them look the same, so the color tells you which one.

levels.title: Big or Small
levels.tipText: This time, listen for big or small.

levels.title: Two Clues
levels.tipText: Two clues now: the color, and the thing. You need both.

levels.title: Three Clues
levels.tipText: Three clues! The size, the color, and the thing. Here is a trick: say it back in your head.

levels.title: Wait For It
levels.tipText: Sometimes the important part comes at the very end. Keep listening until I stop talking.

levels.title: Camp Challenge
levels.tipText: Camp challenge! A mix of everything you have learned so far.

worlds.name: Two-Step Trail
worlds.blurb: Two things to do, in the right order.

levels.title: This, Then That
levels.tipText: Two things to do now. Tap them in the order I say. Then press the green check mark. Made a slip? The arrow takes it back.

levels.title: Two Colors
levels.tipText: Two steps, with colors. Here is a trick: make a picture of each one in your mind.

levels.title: How Many
levels.tipText: Listen for how many times.

levels.title: Listen, Then Look
levels.tipText: This time the cards are hidden while I talk. Listen first, hold it in your head, then look.

levels.title: Memory Trail
levels.tipText: Two steps, and the cards are hidden. Say them back in your head while you wait.

levels.title: Trail Boss
levels.tipText: Trail boss! Two steps, counting, and hidden cards, all mixed up.

worlds.name: Word Woods
worlds.blurb: Tricky words: not, all, except, next to.

levels.title: Not That One
levels.tipText: Tricky word alert: NOT. Listen for the one I do not want.

levels.title: All of Them
levels.tipText: When I say ALL, tap every one that fits. Then press the green check mark.

levels.title: All Except
levels.tipText: Tricky word: EXCEPT. Except means: leave that one out.

levels.title: Where Is It
levels.tipText: Now listen for where things are. Next to. Between. In the middle.

levels.title: Left and Right
levels.tipText: Left and right. Here is a trick: hold up both hands with your thumbs sticking out. The hand that makes an L is your left.

levels.title: Woods Wizard
levels.tipText: Woods challenge! Not, all, except, and where. Listen for the tricky word.

levels.title: First and Then
levels.tipText: First, then, last. These words tell you the order.

levels.title: After That
levels.tipText: Listen for the word AFTER.

levels.title: Before
levels.tipText: Listen for the word BEFORE.

levels.title: Flip It: Before
levels.tipText: Careful! Sometimes I say it backwards. Before you eat, wash your hands. So washing comes first. Listen for BEFORE, and think: what comes first?

levels.title: Flip It: After
levels.tipText: Careful again. Eat after you wash your hands. Washing still comes first. Listen for AFTER, and think: what comes first?

levels.title: Tower Boss
levels.tipText: Tower boss! Before and after, all mixed up. Think: what happens first?

levels.title: Captain Says
levels.tipText: Captain’s rule: only do it if I say, Captain says. If I do not say Captain says, tap the hand.

levels.title: Who Said It
levels.tipText: Sneaky pirates are giving orders too. Only listen to the captain.

levels.title: Only If
levels.tipText: IF is a tricky word. If it is true, do it. If it is not true, tap the hand.

levels.title: If Not
levels.tipText: Now there are two choices. If it is true, do the first thing. If not, do the second.

levels.title: Change of Plan
levels.tipText: Sometimes I change my mind at the end. Wait until I have completely finished.

levels.title: Captain's Test
levels.tipText: Captain’s test! Wait for every word before you move.

levels.title: Three Steps
levels.tipText: Three steps now. Here is a trick: count them on your fingers as you listen.

levels.title: Three With Colors
levels.tipText: Three steps, with colors. Say them back in your head.

levels.title: Three From Memory
levels.tipText: Three steps, and the cards are hidden. You can do it. Picture each one.

levels.title: Four Steps
levels.tipText: Four steps! Take a breath, listen all the way, and go one at a time.

levels.title: Mountain Boss
levels.tipText: Mountain boss! Long instructions. Breathe, listen, and go one step at a time.

worlds.name: Story Cave
worlds.blurb: Listen to a story, then answer.

levels.title: Who and What
levels.tipText: Story time! Listen to the story, then answer my question.

levels.title: Remember the Details
levels.tipText: These stories are a bit longer. Make a movie in your mind as you listen.

levels.title: What Happened First
levels.tipText: Listen for what happens first, next, and last.

levels.title: Story Detective
levels.tipText: Be a detective. I will not tell you the answer. Use the clues to work it out.

levels.title: Cave Boss
levels.tipText: Cave boss! Stories and clues. Make a movie in your mind.

levels.title: Hero Mix
levels.tipText: Hero’s Trial, part one. Clues, steps, and tricky words.

levels.title: Champion Mix
levels.tipText: Hero’s Trial, part two. Wait for the real order, and remember every step.

levels.title: Legend Run
levels.tipText: The Legend Run. Everything you have learned. You are ready.
